senses.zh_definition: 格雷厄姆：苏格兰及英语使用中的男性名字，与 Graham 有历史联系。
senses.en_definition: A masculine given name of Scottish usage, derived from a surname related to Graham.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas lelaki dalam penggunaan Scotland dan bahasa Inggeris, berasal daripada nama keluarga yang berkaitan dengan Graham.
senses.nuances: 这是专有名词释义，并非已核实的 DBP 普通词条，因此不标为 official。英语读音有 /ˈɡɹeɪ.əm/ 和 /ɡɹæm/ 等形式，应遵从本人读法，不按马来语字母逐个拼读。以下搭配为人名使用框架，不代表固定高频词汇搭配。[Behind the Name：Graeme](https://www.behindthename.com/name/graeme)

etymology.historical_story: Graeme developed as a given name from a surname spelling related to Graham. The broader surname history leads to the English place name Grantham, whose meaning is often interpreted as a gravelly homestead. Graeme has a particular association with Scotland, Australia and New Zealand. Its spelling therefore carries naming history rather than a hidden Malay root. [Graeme](https://www.behindthename.com/name/graeme), [Graham](https://www.behindthename.com/name/graham)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Graeme 与相关拼写 Graham 配对记忆；看到 Graeme，先想到人名，再按本人习惯读音。
